digest.lead: Claude Code gets a significant update with v2.1.110, introducing TUI fullscreen mode and mobile push notifications for developers.
digest.summary: Meanwhile, service disruptions affected Claude.ai, API, and Claude Code yesterday, and Anthropic has changed its model versioning policy to prevent API users from pinning to specific model versions.

stories.headline: Anthropic Removes Model Version Pinning for API Users
stories.summary: Anthropic has changed its policy to no longer allow API users to fix requests to specific model versions [1]. The change has drawn community discussion about the implications for production deployments.
key_points: API users can no longer specify exact model versions in requests
Change affects developers who relied on version pinning for consistent behavior
stories.impact: This affects developers using Claude's API in production who need predictable model behavior, potentially requiring updates to deployment strategies and testing workflows.

sources.title: Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allows you to fix to specific model version

stories.headline: Service Disruptions Hit Claude Ecosystem Yesterday
stories.summary: Elevated errors affected Claude.ai, the API, and Claude Code yesterday, generating significant discussion on Hacker News [1]. The outage impacted multiple components of Anthropic's infrastructure simultaneously.
stories.impact: The widespread nature of the outage affected both individual users and developers, highlighting the interconnected nature of Claude's services.

sources.title: Elevated errors on Claude.ai, API, Claude Code

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.110 Adds Fullscreen TUI and Push Notifications
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code update introduces several major features including a `/tui` command for flicker-free fullscreen rendering and mobile push notifications when Remote Control is enabled [1]. The update also reorganizes interface controls and adds new configuration options for auto-scrolling.
key_points: New `/tui fullscreen` command provides flicker-free rendering in the same conversation
Push notifications can be sent to mobile devices when Remote Control and specific configs are enabled
Interface improvements include separate `/focus` command and configurable auto-scroll behavior
stories.impact: These updates significantly improve the developer experience for those using Claude Code as their primary coding interface, especially for extended coding sessions and remote development workflows.

stories.headline: Use `/tui fullscreen` for flicker-free Claude Code rendering
stories.summary: The `/tui fullscreen` command switches Claude Code to a flicker-free rendering mode within the same conversation. This improves visual stability and reduces screen flicker during interactions.
actionable_steps: Press Enter to activate flicker-free rendering mode

stories.headline: Use managed settings drop-in directory for team policy deployment
stories.summary: The new managed-settings.d/ directory allows multiple teams to deploy independent configuration fragments that automatically merge. This enables better organization of team-specific policies without conflicts.
actionable_steps: Create a managed-settings.d/ directory alongside your managed-settings.json
Place individual team policy files in the directory (they merge alphabetically)
Name files with prefixes to control merge order (e.g., 01-team-a.json, 02-team-b.json)

stories.headline: Use Claude's extended thinking for complex architectural decisions
stories.summary: When asking Claude to make non-trivial design choices — like choosing between patterns, structuring a new module, or planning a migration — enabling extended thinking produces significantly better results. Claude will reason through trade-offs before committing to an approach, catching issues that quick responses miss.
actionable_steps: For architecture questions, ask Claude to 'think through the trade-offs' explicitly
Use Claude Code's plan mode (shift+tab) for multi-step tasks that need careful reasoning
Review Claude's reasoning in extended thinking to catch flawed assumptions early

sources.title: Tips for getting better architectural advice from Claude

stories.headline: Set up Google Vertex AI integration using the interactive wizard
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.98 introduced a guided setup wizard that simplifies connecting to Google Vertex AI. This eliminates manual configuration steps and reduces authentication errors by walking you through GCP setup, project selection, and credential verification.
actionable_steps: Open Claude Code and go to the login screen
Follow the interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard
Complete GCP authentication, project and region configuration, and credential verification as prompted

stories.headline: Use forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy to ensure fresh configuration on startup
stories.summary: This setting forces Claude Code CLI to fetch the latest remote managed settings before starting and exits if the fetch fails. This ensures your CLI always runs with the most current configuration and prevents running with stale settings that might cause issues.
actionable_steps: Open your Claude Code CLI configuration
Restart the CLI to verify it blocks startup until fresh settings are fetched
